pointers.sentence: `formset_factory` makes a formset class with `type`: a subclass of `BaseFormSet`, or of the formset class it is given, whose class attributes are its other arguments (`django/forms/formsets.py:formset_factory`).
An instance is bound as a form is, when given data or files (`django/forms/formsets.py:BaseFormSet.__init__`).
`ManagementForm` is a form of four hidden `IntegerField`s (`django/forms/formsets.py:ManagementForm`, `django/forms/fields.py:IntegerField`).
`ManagementForm` is a form of four hidden `IntegerField`s (`django/forms/formsets.py:ManagementForm`, `django/forms/fields.py:IntegerField`).

`BaseFormSet.management_form` makes it once, with the formset's prefix (`django/forms/formsets.py:BaseFormSet.management_form`): unbound, with the formset's counts and limits as initial values; bound, from the formset's data, and cleaned at once.
Two methods count them (`django/forms/formsets.py:BaseFormSet.total_form_count`, `django/forms/formsets.py:BaseFormSet.initial_form_count`).
Two methods count them (`django/forms/formsets.py:BaseFormSet.total_form_count`, `django/forms/formsets.py:BaseFormSet.initial_form_count`).
`BaseFormSet.forms` makes the forms on first use and keeps them, one for each index below the total count, by `BaseFormSet._construct_form` (`django/forms/formsets.py:BaseFormSet.forms`).

`_construct_form` gives form i the formset's prefix, a hyphen and i, `"form-0"`; when the formset is bound, its whole data and files, of which the form reads only the keys under its prefix (`django/forms/forms.py:BaseForm.add_prefix`); the i-th dictionary of `initial`, if there is one; and two arguments a form alone seldom has.

Keyword arguments from the hook `BaseFormSet.get_form_kwargs`, a copy of `form_kwargs`, override all of these, and `BaseFormSet.add_fields` then adds its fields (`django/forms/formsets.py:BaseFormSet._construct_form`):
`BaseFormSet.add_fields` adds fields to each form's own copy of its class's fields, leaving the class untouched (`django/forms/formsets.py:BaseFormSet.add_fields`).

With `can_delete=True`, it adds `"DELETE"`, a `BooleanField` drawn by `BaseFormSet.deletion_widget`, a `CheckboxInput`, not required: on every form, or with `can_delete_extra=False` on the initial forms only (`django/forms/fields.py:BooleanField`).

`BaseFormSet.ordered_forms` is the forms by their `"ORDER"`, a blank one last, deleted forms and unchanged extra forms left out; it raises `AttributeError` when the formset is invalid or cannot order (`django/forms/formsets.py:BaseFormSet.ordered_forms`).

`BaseFormSet.empty_form` is a form made afresh at each use, with the prefix `"form-__prefix__"`, `empty_permitted=True` and no `"required"` attributes (`django/forms/formsets.py:BaseFormSet.empty_form`).
The admin's inline formsets add rows so (`django/contrib/admin/static/admin/js/inlines.js`).

A formset is validated the first time its errors are asked for: `BaseFormSet.errors` and `BaseFormSet.non_form_errors` call `BaseFormSet.full_clean` if it has not run (`django/forms/formsets.py:BaseFormSet.full_clean`).

`BaseFormSet.is_valid` is false for an unbound formset; otherwise it asks every form not marked for deletion, without stopping at the first invalid one, and is true when they are all valid and the formset has no errors of its own (`django/forms/formsets.py:BaseFormSet.is_valid`).

`all_valid` asks every formset in a list, all of them even after one fails; the admin's add and change view checks its inline formsets with it (`django/forms/formsets.py:all_valid`, `django/contrib/admin/options.py:ModelAdmin._changeform_view`).

`BaseFormSet.template_name` is the renderer's `formset_template_name`, `"django/forms/formsets/div.html"` (`django/forms/renderers.py:BaseRenderer`); `as_p` and the other three take `BaseFormSet.template_name_p` and its siblings.

Each template writes the management form, then each form by the form's method of the same style, which draws it by the form's `template_name_div` or a sibling, not by the renderer's `form_template_name` (`django/forms/templates/django/forms/formsets/div.html`).
